prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want — UV beds, spray (sunless) tans, quick mobile spray, budget membership, or a luxury spa experience. I can give specific salon recommendations if you tell me which neighborhood or zip code and whether you want UV or spray. 

Until then, quick guidance and next steps:

- Decide type: spray/sunless is far safer (no UV) and gives predictable results; beds give a “real” tan but raise skin-cancer risk.  
- What to look for: up-to-date equipment, certified spray technicians, good hygiene, clear pricing/packages, visible before/after photos, current online reviews (Google/Yelp/Facebook), and willingness to do a patch test/consultation.  
- Chains commonly in Charlotte that are worth checking: Palm Beach Tan and Sun Tan City — they have multiple locations and consistent pricing/equipment. Independent salons and boutique spray bars often get top local reviews for personalized results.  
- How to choose fast: search “spray tan near me” or “tanning salon near [zip]” on Google or Yelp, filter 4+ star places, read several recent reviews (look for comments about color, streaking, prep instructions, and cleanliness), and call to ask about technician experience and what products they use.  

If you tell me your neighborhood/zip and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll pull together a short list of the top-rated salons in Charlotte and what each one specializes in.
